## Problem or Motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it. E.g. "When processing burial registers, I can't..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Be as specific as you can.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, and why you'd prefer your proposed solution.

## Heritage / Archival Context

If relevant, describe the record type, institution, or workflow this would support. The more context, the better — this helps prioritise features that serve the broadest range of heritage use cases.

## Additional Notes

Screenshots, examples, or links to relevant resources.
